captions.caption: Aerial view of a military vehicle on a dirt road in a field.
The vehicle remains stationary as the camera observes from above.
A massive fireball erupts from the ground near the vehicle.
The explosion expands into a large orange and black cloud.
A thick plume of smoke and dust rises high into the air.
The blast cloud continues to billow and grow in size.
Smoke from the explosion starts to drift across the landscape.
The aerial shot shows the scale of the smoke plume over the fields.
Dust and debris settle around the impact site.
The smoke cloud reaches its maximum height.
The column of smoke begins to dissipate slowly.
Aerial view of the smoke cloud from a slightly different angle.
The smoke continues to rise from the blast crater.
The cloud of dust and smoke covers a large area of the field.
The aerial camera focuses on the core of the smoke plume.
The smoke cloud starts to thin out as it rises.
A wide shot captures the smoke column against the rural backdrop.
The smoke continues to linger over the explosion site.
The aerial view shows the smoke cloud dissipating in the wind.
A soldier sits on the ground leaning against a low wall.
The soldier rests with a rifle while looking into the distance.
A helmet-mounted camera is visible on the soldier's head.
The soldier remains stationary in the quiet, open field.
The low light of dawn or dusk illuminates the scene.
The soldier continues to observe his surroundings.
The soldier's gear and backpack are positioned next to him.
The soldier sits calmly as he waits for further action.
The soldier looks towards a large mud-brick structure.
The soldier maintains a steady gaze on the horizon.
The soldier remains in a seated position against the wall.
The soldier's rifle rests across his lap.
The soldier continues his watch in the peaceful environment.
The soldier's breathing is audible in the quiet air.
The soldier stays focused on the target area ahead.
The sky begins to brighten as time passes.
The soldier's helmet camera captures the view from his perspective.
The soldier remains still, waiting for the upcoming blast.
The soldier continues his observation from the ground.
An explosion occurs behind the distant wall.
A plume of dust and debris shoots up into the air.
The soldier watches as the dust cloud rises from the blast.
The dust cloud from the explosion begins to settle.
Debris from the explosion falls back down to earth.
Dust lingers in the air around the struck wall.
The scene shows the rubble of a destroyed building.
Large pieces of mud-brick debris are piled on the ground.
The camera pans over the remains of the structure.
More rubble is visible in the courtyard of the house.
The destruction of the building is shown from a close angle.
Dust and debris cover the area inside the walls.
The camera captures the extent of the damage to the home.
A pile of debris sits where a wall once stood.
Soldiers walk through a narrow alley with tall mud walls.
The soldiers move in a line, carrying their rifles.
A soldier leading the group surveys the alley ahead.
The soldiers walk cautiously along the dusty path.
The narrow passage is enclosed by high, earthen walls.
Soldiers continue their movement through the village alley.
The soldiers' gear clinks as they advance through the passage.
One soldier checks a doorway along the alley wall.
